title: Atet's Infrastructure
description: A lightweight server-side mod that lets admins assign repeating item rewards to players.
body:
## Atet's Infrastructure
is a lightweight server-side utility mod that allows server administrators to assign repeating item rewards to players on a configurable timer. Perfect for RPG servers, economy servers, or any server that wants to reward players with a salary, daily login bonus, or passive income system.
No client installation required — vanilla clients can connect and receive rewards without ever installing the mod.

### Commands
All commands require OP level 2.

/infrastructure give <player> <item> <amount> <hours> — Assign a repeating item reward to a player. Supports decimal values for hours, e.g. 0.5 for every 30 minutes.

/infrastructure list <player> — View all active rewards assigned to a player and their intervals.

/infrastructure remove <player> <item> — Remove a specific reward from a player.

### Q&A
**What happens if a player is offline when a reward is due?**
The reward is saved and all missed intervals are delivered at once the next time they log in.

**Do rewards persist across server restarts?**
Yes. All reward data is saved to a JSON file inside the world folder and loaded automatically when the server starts back up.

**Does the player need to install the mod?**
No. This is a server-side only mod. Vanilla clients can connect and receive rewards normally.

**Can I assign multiple different items to the same player?**
Yes. Each player can have as many different item rewards as you want, each with their own interval.

**Can I update an existing reward?**
Yes. Running /infrastructure give again for the same player and item will replace the existing reward with the new values.

**What is the minimum interval?**
0.1 hours, which is 6 minutes. Useful for testing.
